slides.notes: Market activity does not prove demand for Rabovel. The cNGN and paired-transfer advantage is a hypothesis. Banking, eligibility, allocation and legal ownership are separate boundaries.

slides.lead: Potential differentiation: cNGN + delivery + reconciled intermediary operations.

Clear local asset rights and lifecycle
slides.prompt: Name the buyer’s current alternative and the outcome that would justify switching.
slides.notes: Direct local alternatives and adjacent analogues are different categories. Crafts: Frontier winner; equity-linked startup fundraising, not Nigerian brokerage. Credible Finance: Cypherpunk stablecoins runner-up, C4 accelerator; remittance infrastructure, not securities permission. Their archived demos had execution limits. No feature scorecard or inferred market leadership.

slides.title: Start with buyer economics
slides.lead: 186 active broker entries are a buyer universe, not qualified demand.
slides.prompt: Validate qualified firms, budgets, annual supported value and direct costs.
slides.notes: Arithmetic: 3×₦6m + ₦5bn×0.0005 = ₦20.5m. Hypothetical capacity, not forecast, pipeline or traction. Five bps = 0.05%. Costs, taxes, integration revenue and partner payouts excluded. Active broker directory count does not include all issuing firms or prove eligibility. PDF header October 5 versus filename September 21 discrepancy recorded. Full-universe subscription sensitivity: 186×₦6m = ₦1.116bn/year, not validated TAM. Expansion and repeat use required to substantiate venture-scale opportunity.

slides.prompt: Technology-provider positioning does not determine licensing obligations.
slides.notes: SEC January 2026 circular includes RATOP/DAOP ₦1bn, DAPO/DAI ₦500m, digital-asset exchange/custodian ₦2bn, compliance deadline June 30 2027. Classification of Rabovel unresolved. These are capital requirements, not integration costs. Investor self-signing, server issuer signing and broker payment destination describe demo mechanics, not a completed custody model.

slides.title: Show proof in 2 minutes 40 seconds
slides.lead: Verify a real integrated devnet run before recording.
rows: Prepared mint, inventory and live listing
Whole units, price, cNGN total and fee roles
Both transfers and corresponding balance changes
Simulated inputs; legal and recovery boundaries
slides.prompt: A transaction explorer proves onchain effects; it does not prove legal share ownership.
slides.notes: Total 160 seconds; separate from 165-second pitch. Some preparation may be prerecorded but must be disclosed. Do not present fixture screens as functional integration. Eligibility preparation occurs separately. Confirmed commitment, bank timing and legal register updates are different concepts. Record only identifiers actually produced by the verified run.

slides.title: Capacity scenarios, not forecasts
slides.lead: Annual software + settled-value fees. All commercial inputs are assumptions.
slides.prompt: Direct costs and margins are unknown. Obtain partner quotes before stating profitability.
slides.notes: Annual revenue = firms×annual fee + aggregate annual settled value×0.0005 (five basis points). Integration fees, taxes and partner payouts excluded. Contribution = revenue − direct cost. Break-even requires positive contribution and fixed operating costs. Directory universe sensitivity is not qualified SAM. Do not annualize cumulative NGX fundraising or use market capitalization as revenue TAM.

slides.title: Match each claim to evidence
slides.lead: No public numerical weights found. Address both FAQ and formal event criteria.
rows: Founder voice and precise asset rights
Actual demand and later paid usage
slides.prompt: Formal rules also call for functionality, impact, novelty, UX and open-source composition.
slides.notes: This is an evidence checklist, not a numerical grade. Describe Solana/Token-2022/ACL composition accurately, provide repository access and disclose pre-existing code. Winner analogues do not substitute for Rabovel customer evidence.

slides.title: Sources and limits
slides.lead: Research cut: 7 October 2026. Full source register accompanies this deck.
slides.prompt: Company pages describe their products; they do not independently establish performance.
slides.notes: Public sources, full Copilot project records and Grid discovery were cross-checked. No customer interviews were conducted, no live network purchase was executed and no external outreach was sent. The NGX report is republished press; broker directory has a filename/header date discrepancy. Forecasts and licenses are not established. Deadline October 12 11:59 p.m. PT / October 13 12:59 a.m. Edmonton; submit earlier on October 12 locally. Event rules specify winners by December 5.
